title: Northgate Care Protection Plans Refund Terms by Plan
content:
Refunds of a Northgate Care Protection Plans charge are governed by the figures and switches in this table: the full-refund period after plan purchase, whether a later cancellation refunds the unused whole months, the administrative fee deducted from such a prorated refund, whether claims already paid are deducted, whether returning the covered product cancels the plan with a full refund, and where the refund is paid.

## Refund terms

| Plan | Full-refund period after plan purchase | Later cancellation refunds unused whole months | Administrative fee on a prorated refund (USD) | Claims already paid deducted from the refund | Returning the covered product cancels the plan with a full refund | Refund paid to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan | 30 calendar days | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | Yes | the original tender |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan | 30 calendar days | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | Yes | the original tender |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection | 30 calendar days | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | Yes | the original tender |
| Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan | 30 calendar days | Yes | 25.00 | Yes | Yes | the original tender |
| Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan | 30 calendar days | Yes | 25.00 | Yes | Yes | the original tender |
| Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan | 30 calendar days | Yes | 25.00 | Yes | Yes | the original tender |

## Where the plans differ

The only figure that differs between plans is the administrative fee: no fee (0.00) under the three electronics plans — the Northgate Care 2-Year Electronics Plan, the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan and the Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection — and a fee of 25.00 under the Northgate Care 4-Year Mattress & Furniture Plan, the Northgate Care 3-Year Appliance Plan and the Northgate Care 5-Year Appliance Plan. The fee is deducted from a prorated refund; the table gives no fee on any other refund.

Every plan shares the 30-calendar-day full-refund period, the prorated refund of unused whole months, the deduction of claims already paid, the cancellation with a full refund when the covered product is returned, and payment of the refund to the original tender.
